title.narrative: Civil Society Engagements for Civic Space and Democratisation in South S

description.narrative:
The goal of the project is to strengthen civil society actors so that they engage and claim civic space for democratisation in South Sudan.The project has three priorities:
- Strengthen civil society's capacity to coordinate and engage with civic and political leaders and claim civic space. - Advance legislative reform to enable respect for human rights and inclusion of women and youth in decision-making processes. - Promote civic education and engagement with grass-roots communities on civil rights and electoral processes.
Indicative Activities: During the implementation of this project, selected partners will submit applications with tailored activities that will be in line with the broad results anticipated under the project. Some of the indicative activities will include: o Holding of civic space roundtables which shall bring together key political and security sector leaders. o Town hall engagements at a subnational level between citizens and political leaders to discuss democratisation, violation of human rights etc. o Radio programmes to encourage dialogues on national values, democratic principles and the role of citizens in bringing positive change in the country including through nonviolent means. o Use of arts and social media to promote democratisation o Youth mentorship initiatives through democratic clubs in schools and workshops to ensure that they learned democratic principles and values, because as they say, ‘no one is more dangerous than a misguided youth’. o Consultative community dialogues and civic education including on pending pieces of legislation including the permanent constitution. o Civil society strategy and coordination meetings to build consensus on peace, human rights, and democratic-related processes and be able to issue common positions to influence other stakeholders’ decisions. o Support to civil society technical teams during the Kenya-mediated peace talks for South Sudan.
